title: Price Discovery When the Benchmark Is Closed: Evidence from 24/7 Perpetual Futures
summary: Do not turn benchmark-closed price discovery into another Sunday-gap strategy.
about: Price discovery in continuously traded perpetual markets while a reference market is shut.
findings: Authors report reference-price transmission; no executable CME return verified.
mechanism: Information aggregation is not proof of a tradable next-price gap.
build_on: Needs the actual venue, reference, quotes and funding; a CME Sunday gap is a different trade.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Not faithfully from owned CME OHLCV alone.
reading_scope: Indexed metadata or abstract only; not full-text evidence.
